instructions.en: Tier-I has 100 multiple-choice questions for 200 marks in 60 minutes: General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Comprehension, with 25 questions and 50 marks each and a 15-minute timer for each subject. Each wrong answer costs 0.50 marks. Questions are in English and Hindi, except English Comprehension. Tier-I is used only to shortlist candidates for Tier-II.
instructions.hi: टियर-I में 200 अंकों के 100 बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न हैं, जिनके लिए 60 मिनट मिलते हैं: सामान्य बुद्धि एवं तर्कशक्ति, सामान्य जागरूकता, मात्रात्मक योग्यता और अंग्रेज़ी बोध, प्रत्येक में 25 प्रश्न और 50 अंक, और हर विषय के लिए 15 मिनट का अलग टाइमर। हर गलत उत्तर पर 0.50 अंक कटते हैं। अंग्रेज़ी बोध को छोड़कर प्रश्न अंग्रेज़ी और हिंदी में होते हैं। टियर-I का उपयोग केवल टियर-II के लिए उम्मीदवारों को शॉर्टलिस्ट करने में होता है।

open_questions.question: The notice is printed in English and Hindi (para 23(a), PDF p.48), but only the English notice was retrieved. Hindi titles here are translations (hi_source: translation); replace them with the official Hindi wording.
Normalisation of multi-shift scores follows the SSC procedure published in the Notice dated 02-06-2025 (para 13.2, PDF p.24). That notice was not retrieved, so scoring.normalization only names it.
The notice does not say whether a calculator (on-screen or physical) is allowed. calculator stays null.
Shift timings are not stated in the notice; they appear on the Admission Certificate. shift_timings stays null.
The number of options per question is not stated in the notice. options_per_question stays null.
The order of the four subjects on screen and whether candidates can move between them within the hour are not stated. section_navigation stays null.
The paper has no numeric-entry questions, so the notice states no way of typing numbers.
